       ROUND(CAST((ar.histsignrating + ar.researchvalrating + ar.cultscore) AS numeric) / 3, 2) as avg_score,
       ROUND(CAST((ar.histsignrating + ar.researchvalrating) AS numeric) / 2, 2) as hist_research_avg

LIMIT 10;

WITH artifact_data AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry,
        a.artdynasty,
        a.conservestatus,
        ar.histsignrating,
        ar.researchvalrating,
        ar.cultscore,
        cm.budgetallocstatus,
        ROUND(CAST((ar.histsignrating + ar.researchvalrating) AS numeric) / 2, 2) as cpi
    FROM artifactscore a
    LEFT JOIN artifactratings ar ON a.artregistry = ar.artref
    LEFT JOIN conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
),
dynasty_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        artdynasty,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(cpi) AS numeric), 2) as total_priority_score,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1 END) as adequate_funding_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) as insufficient_funding_count,
        COUNT(*) as total_artifacts,
        -- CBE: proportion of artifacts with adequate funding weighted by CPI
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(cpi * CASE WHEN budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS numeric) / COUNT(*) / NULLIF(ROUND(CAST(AVG(cpi) AS numeric), 2), 0), 4) as cbe
    FROM artifact_data
    GROUP BY artdynasty
)

    artdynasty as dynasty_name,
    total_priority_score,
    adequate_funding_count,
    insufficient_funding_count,
    cbe as budget_efficiency_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN cbe < 0.5 AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM artifact_data ad 
            WHERE ad.artdynasty = ds.artdynasty 
            AND ad.conservestatus = 'Critical' 
            AND ad.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient'
        ) THEN 'Budget Crisis'
        ELSE 'Within Budget'
    END as budget_status
FROM dynasty_stats ds
